summary: Execution of decree for specific performance; interpretation of Section 47 CPC and Order XXI Rule 97 CPC; application for amendment in execution petition; scope of revision under Section 115 CPC; procedural law subservient to justice; dispute resolution in execution proceedings to prevent multiplicity of litigation; affirmation of ASJ orders allowing respondent's application under Section 47 and rejecting amendment.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 o.XXI r.97
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned judgment of Madras High Court set aside; execution proceedings to proceed as per law.
